status_note: No equipment schedule exists in the design model or the brief. Every record below is an ASSUMED typical Egyptian-villa value (electrical input power, not cooling or heating output). None is a manufacturer datasheet figure. The client should correct or confirm each line; the engine re-runs from this file.

gate.basis: vehicle gate at the street fence at the head of the car ramp (slab-ramp centre line y; street fence x)

deck.basis: centre of slab-deck, the parking deck over the basement extension

equipment.name: Split AC 1.5 HP
equipment.reason: one inverter split per bedroom; 1.5 HP (about 12,000 BTU/h) draws about 1.2 kW for a 13 m2 room

equipment.name: Split AC 1.5 HP
equipment.reason: one inverter split per bedroom; 1.5 HP for a 13 m2 room

equipment.name: Split AC 2 HP
equipment.reason: master bedroom 12.7 m2 plus dressing; 2 HP (about 18,000 BTU/h) draws about 1.7 kW

equipment.name: Split AC 1.5 HP
equipment.reason: study / game room 15.6 m2 with a glazed deck door: 1.5 HP, upsize to 2 HP if the client uses it as a game room

equipment.name: Split AC 3 HP
equipment.reason: lounge 23 m2 open to the family corner: 3 HP (about 24,000 BTU/h) draws about 2.4 kW

equipment.name: Split AC 2 HP
equipment.reason: windowless 18 m2 room with a seated audience and projector heat: 2 HP

equipment.name: Split AC 3 HP
equipment.reason: garden living room 21 m2, large glazing: 3 HP

equipment.name: Split AC 2 HP
equipment.reason: dining 10.7 m2 open to the kitchen: one 2 HP split serves both

equipment.name: Storage water heater 50 L
equipment.reason: one electric storage heater per bathroom, the common Egyptian arrangement; 50 L / 2 kW

equipment.name: Storage water heater 50 L
equipment.reason: one electric storage heater per bathroom; 50 L / 2 kW for the bath

equipment.name: Storage water heater 30 L
equipment.reason: guest shower only: 30 L / 1.5 kW

equipment.name: Built-in electric oven
equipment.reason: oven and hob are in the lane brief's list of items to assume; 3 kW single-phase built-in oven

equipment.name: Induction hob 4 zone
equipment.reason: electric induction hob assumed; a gas hob would remove this 6 kW (32 A) circuit. The dirty kitchen is assumed gas for heavy cooking

equipment.name: Dishwasher
equipment.reason: built-in 12-place dishwasher, cold fill

equipment.name: Fridge-freezer
equipment.reason: side-by-side fridge-freezer on its own circuit so a fault elsewhere does not spoil food; 0.4 kW including defrost

equipment.name: Chest freezer
equipment.reason: second freezer in the pantry, common for Egyptian households that buy in bulk

equipment.name: Washing machine
equipment.reason: front-loader with a heating element, 2.2 kW

equipment.name: Tumble dryer
equipment.reason: condenser or vented dryer, 2.5 kW; omit if the client dries outdoors

equipment.name: Water booster pump
equipment.reason: pressure set from the ground tank to the roof/apartment risers; 1.1 kW (1.5 HP), location assumed in the store under the ramp

equipment.name: Irrigation pump
equipment.reason: garden irrigation pump 0.55 kW; the garden is a large part of the brief

equipment.name: Sliding gate motor
equipment.reason: sliding vehicle gate at the head of the ramp, 0.4 kW

equipment.name: EV-ready point (7.4 kW wallbox)
equipment.reason: EV-ready: 32 A circuit installed to the parking deck, charger later; counted at full load so the service is sized for it

equipment.name: Garden lighting (LV transformer)
equipment.reason: the model has no exterior luminaires; one allowance of 300 W for garden path/uplight drivers until the exterior lighting design exists

equipment.name: ELV rack, PoE switch, NVR, UPS
equipment.reason: structured cabling cabinet with PoE switch, CCTV recorder and UPS; location assumed in the under-stair cupboard, stair-b

equipment.name: Gate intercom station and camera supply
equipment.reason: video intercom and gate camera power at the gate

equipment.name: Interlinked smoke/heat alarms, both levels
equipment.reason: one dedicated radial feeds all mains alarms on both levels so the hard-wired interlink stays on one phase (about 17 units, a few W each); 25 m allowance for the run up to the ground floor
